fgsea is an R-package for fast preranked gene set enrichment analysis (GSEA).
The fgsea package allows to quickly and accurately calculate arbitrarily low GSEA P-values for a collection of gene sets.
P-value estimation in fgsea is based on an adaptive multi-level split Monte-Carlo scheme.
The fgsea package default lower bound for estimating P-values is eps=1e-10.
GESECA is a method to identify gene sets that have high gene correlation.
GESECA takes as input a gene expression matrix E where rows and columns correspond to genes and samples respectively, and a list of gene sets P.
By default, GESECA method performs centering for rows of the matrix E.
GESECA score does not require an explicit sample annotation or a contrast.
GESECA can be applied to various types of sequencing technologies including RNA-seq, single-cell sequencing, and spatial RNA-seq.
GESECA assesses statistical significance for a given gene set by using gene permutations.
GESECA uses an adaptive multilevel Markov Chain Monte Carlo scheme for P-value estimation.
The first example in the GESECA tutorial considers a time course data of Th2 activation from the dataset GSE200250.
HALLMARK_E2F_TARGETS genes are strongly activated at 24 hours time point in Th2 cells. HALLMARK_HYPOXIA genes are activated around 48 hours in Th2 cells.
When the expression matrix contains many samples, a PCA-reduced expression matrix can be used instead of the full matrix to improve performance.
The sample space was reduced from a higher dimension to 10 dimensions in one GESECA example.
GESECA scores and P-values obtained on a reduced matrix are similar to those obtained for the full matrix.
The GSE116240 dataset features single cell RNA sequencing of aortic CD45+ cells and foam cells from atherosclerotic aorta.
Inflammatory pathways such as KEGG_LEISHMANIA_INFECTION are more associated with non-foamy intimal macrophages.
KEGG_LYSOSOME pathway is specific to intimal foamy macrophages.
GESECA can be used for gene set enrichment analysis of spatial transcriptomics profiling.
A glioblastoma sample analyzed with GESECA shows a distinct hypoxic region defined by HALLMARK_HYPOXIA.
HALLMARK_INTERFERON_GAMMA_RESPONSE defines a reactive immune region in glioblastoma.
HALLMARK_OXIDATIVE_PHOSPHORYLATION pathway is more characteristic to normal tissue regions compared to diseased regions.
GESECA can be applied to spatial transcriptomics data generated by high-plex in situ technologies with subcellular resolution such as 10X Genomics' Xenium platform.
A Human Ovarian Cancer sample was profiled using the Xenium 5K panel in a GESECA analysis example.
SCTransform normalization was performed on 10000 genes in Xenium data analysis.
Reverse PCA with 50 principal components was performed on Xenium scRNA-seq data. Reverse PCA with 30 principal components was performed on Xenium spatial transcriptomics data.
HALLMARK gene sets from MSigDB collection were used in Xenium GESECA analysis.
Top enriched pathways identified by GESECA in Xenium data were visualized using UMAP embeddings.
The plotCoregulationProfileImage function enables visualization of how pathway activities vary across spatial coordinates in Xenium data.
An R-package for performing GESECA (GEne SEt Co-regulation Analysis) is available.
The exampleExpressionMatrix is a numeric expression matrix of the GSE14308 dataset with 10000 rows corresponding to genes and 12 columns corresponding to samples.
The exampleExpressionMatrix values are log-scaled and the samples are quantile normalized.
examplePathways is a list of mouse pathways from the reactome.db package.

The 5991851_Mitotic_Prometaphase pathway had a pctEvar of 0.7485590 and a pval of 1.409623e-24 in GESECA analysis.

The collapsePathways function can be used to select only independent pathways in fgsea results.

fgsea is parallelized using the BiocParallel package.
